provenance.followup_title: Gut microbiome profiles to exclude the diagnosis of hepatic encephalopathy in patients with cirrhosis
provenance.relationship_evidence: 后续论文明确说明部分内容曾在 DDW 2024 作口头全体报告；与 869 共享 Bajaj、O’Leary、Jakab、Sikaroodi、Gillevet 五名作者及肝硬化肠道菌群机器学习鉴别肝性脑病任务。结合会议题名和作者确定为该研究的后续完整论文。
provenance.version_limitations: 后续作者表增加 Andrew Fagan，未列会议记录中的 Nicolas Chong；后续摘要中的样本量、20 物种模型及结果属于 2024-08 正式论文，不声称与 2024-05 会议摘要逐字或逐数一致。
provenance.text_handling: 后续作者摘要原文，保留文字和数值，仅去除 XML 标记；单独前置来源警示，不将后续版本伪称原会议摘要。

resolutions.followup_abstract: Patients with cirrhosis who have cognitive complaints are presumed to have hepatic encephalopathy (HE), which leads to unwarranted medications while ignoring the underlying disease process causing these complaints. Since neuropsychological testing, the current gold standard for HE diagnosis, is not readily available, an orderable test is needed. We aimed to develop and validate a rapid gut microbiota test to exclude HE and determine stakeholder input on this approach. Stool was collected from two cohorts: a two-center training cohort (n = 305, on/not on HE-related therapy) and a multicenter validation cohort (n = 30, on HE treatment). Stool microbiota was analyzed rapidly using nanopore analysis. Stakeholder (patients and clinicians) needs assessment was evaluated using semi-quantitative questionnaires. In the training cohort, machine learning using neural network identified a 20-species signature that differentiated HE vs no-HE with 84% specificity compared to the gold standard neuropsychological testing. This high specificity persisted regardless of whether patients were on HE-related therapy or not. In the validation cohort, application of this profile led to reevaluation of the HE diagnosis and treatment in > 40% of the patients. This approach was acceptable to patients (Veterans in the validation cohort) and clinician (n = 40 nationwide) stakeholders. We conclude that a machine learning stool signature based on 20 microbial species developed in a training set and validated in a separate multicenter prospective cohort differentiated those with vs. without HE, identified patients misdiagnosed with HE, and was acceptable to patients and clinician stakeholders.

provenance.followup_title: PanMETAI - a high performance tabular foundation model for accurate pancreatic cancer diagnosis via NMR metabolomics
provenance.relationship_evidence: 会议记录的全部五名作者 Dan-Ni Wu、Joey Jen、Chao-Ping Hsu、Yu-Ting Chang、Chun-Mei Hu 均出现在后续论文，NMR 代谢组学加 SVM 诊断胰腺导管腺癌的任务一致；作者 ORCID 另确认 DDW 2024 口头报告。作为同一团队的后续扩展研究使用；对应关系基于作者和研究方法推断，未找到会议 DOI 的显式版本声明。
provenance.version_limitations: 后续论文扩展为 multilayer SVM、AutoGluon 和 TabPFN-PanMETAI，并包含 902 名参与者及外部验证；不能把后续模型、样本量或性能回填为 2024 会议结果。采用 PMC 当前公开版本；已核对 2026-04-17 作者更正（10.1038/s41467-026-72208-y），仅补正图 3 的台湾和立陶宛队列标签，未更改摘要。

resolutions.followup_abstract: Late diagnosis and the lack of effective early detection techniques contribute to the poor prognosis of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC). To address this challenge, we develop ¹H NMR-based metabolomics–AI platforms employing customized multilayer support vector machine (SVM), AutoGluon, and Tabular Foundation Model (TabPFN) frameworks. These platforms integrate serum metabolomic profiles—including small-molecule metabolites and lipoproteins—with clinical/biochemical parameters (age, CA19-9) and Activin A, derived from 902 participants (424 high-risk controls and 478 PDAC cases). Our TabPFN-based algorithm, PanMETAI, outperform state-of-the-art models. In the Taiwanese training and validation cohort, the model achieved an impressive AUC of 0.99 (95% CI: 0.98–0.99). Its robustness is further confirmed in a Lithuanian external validation cohort (n = 322), which yields an AUC of 0.93 (0.90-0.95). Notably, it identifies key signature patterns that improve early-stage (I/II) PDAC diagnosis and perform well with small sample sizes (n = 50). TabPFN-PanMETAI offers a rapid, accurate, and non-invasive tool for early PDAC detection, with strong potential for clinical application.

provenance.reviewer_summary_of_followup_abstract: 后续研究分析 195 名儿童的无病理异常十二指肠活检，并在另一个 43 人队列中分析 RNA-seq。临床聚类和转录组学显示组间差异，组织图像与细胞分析的分离能力有限。该总结仅概述 2026 预印本；不是作者原文，也不反推 2024 报告的结果。
